extension.summary: Three seasonal splash scenes for Arctic
extension.description: Fuji, Japanese countryside and Tokyo street artwork with four seasons, hourly lighting, weather effects and native skin animation recipes. Shared lossless transparency masks and mixed WebP compression keep the complete resource below 100 MB. Requires a skin implementing the version 2 diffuse-mask contract.

Japanese weather cards at 320 x 720: original illustrations, simplified watercolours, minimal woodblock prints and a layered animated woodblock set. Static landscape woodblock artwork at 1280 x 720 is available for weather dialogs. Each set covers Kodi weather codes 0-47 and na. Animated artwork uses static plates and up to five single-frame PNGs per effect.

extension.summary: One-time setup for the ChadFlix look
extension.description: Run once after installing. Installs and enables the add-ons the look needs, applies the ChadFlix layout settings to Arctic Fuse 3 (skipping its setup wizard), switches to the skin and adds five remote-control key files. Its first menu also has "Undo ChadFlix Keymaps" for going back to another skin. Safe to run again. Never touches sign-ins, keys or watch history; backs up any file it replaces.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial. The setup answers Kodi's "Keep skin?" question itself after switching the skin (that question only).
